subject: Status: repro done, taxonomy mapping is the critical path
body:
Status.

Repro: done via the released notebooks with preset settings — our runs reproduce the paper's part-parsing results on the Zenodo benchmark data within normal variance, and the factorized attribute heads behave as described: the object/part factorization is where the gains come from, and ablating it drops part mIoU noticeably.

Gustavo's pipeline conversion is about 80% there — training now runs headless under the scheduler in the containerized 3.7 environment, with checkpointing the notebooks lacked.

The real issue is our internal part-annotated set: our part taxonomy doesn't align one-to-one with the paper's — we split some parts finer and merge others — so Katya is building a mapping layer plus adjudication rules for the ambiguous classes before the June evals can be trusted.

Risk: that mapping work is the critical path. If it slips past Jun 1, the Jun 12 recommendation slips with it.

Csilla
